node.statement: By the registered theta-idempotent-approximation-map power-series estimate, applied to the delta-projection Q in the epsilon-Banach-C*-algebra, there are universal K_1<infinity and e_1>0 such that e<=e_1 implies ||tilde Q-Q||<=K_1*e, where tilde Q=Co_Q(Q)=u_Q by the registered column-hilbert-inner-product-displays.
